name: @react-querybuilder/mcp

tools.name: format_query
tools.description: Convert a React Query Builder (RQB) query object to another format with the library's own formatQuery (v8.26.0). Prefer this over hand-writing SQL/Mongo/etc. from an RQB query. Formats: sql, parameterized, parameterized_named, mongodb_query, mongodb, cel, spel, jsonlogic, elasticsearch, jsonata, ldap, cypher, gql, sparql, gremlin, pinecone, chroma, qdrant, weaviate, milvus, natural_language, json, json_without_ids, diagnostics. String outputs: sql, mongodb (JSON string), cel, spel, jsonata, ldap, cypher, gql, sparql, gremlin, milvus (vector DB filter expr), natural_language, json, json_without_ids. Object outputs: parameterized/parameterized_named ({ sql, params }), mongodb_query, jsonlogic, elasticsearch, pinecone/chroma/qdrant/weaviate (vector DB metadata filters), diagnostics. Use "natural_language" to explain a query in plain English. Pass options.fields for field-aware output (e.g. parseNumbers by inputType). ORM formats (drizzle, prisma, sequelize, tanstack_db) need live ORM objects and are not supported here.

query.description: RQB query object (`RuleGroupType` `{ combinator, rules: [...] }` or `RuleGroupTypeIC` `{ rules: [rule, "and", rule, ...] }`), or its JSON string. `id`s optional.

format.description: Target format. ORM formats (drizzle, prisma, sequelize, tanstack_db) are not supported over MCP; they return an error with guidance.

fields.description: Field definitions: JSON subset of RQB `Field` — `name`, `label`, `operators`, `values`, `inputType`, `valueEditorType`, `valueSources`, `datatype`, etc. Array (option groups `{ label, options }` allowed) or object map keyed by field name. Function props (`validator`, etc.) are impossible over JSON. Strongly recommended: improves accuracy.

parseNumbers.description: Render numeric-looking values as numbers. `true`/"enhanced"/"native"/"strict" (+ "-limited" = only fields with numeric `inputType`).

quoteFieldNamesWith.description: Quote field names with this string, or [prefix, suffix] (e.g. ["[", "]"]).

fieldIdentifierSeparator.description: Split field names on this (e.g. ".") before quoting parts.

quoteValuesWith.description: String value quote char for sql (default `'`).

preserveValueOrder.description: Keep between/notBetween value order as given.

fallbackExpression.description: Expression emitted in place of invalid/empty groups.

placeholderFieldName.description: Rules with this field are ignored (default "~").

placeholderOperatorName.description: Rules with this operator are ignored (default "~").

placeholderValueName.description: Rules with this value are ignored.

concatOperator.description: SQL concat operator for contains/beginsWith/etc. with field values.

tools.name: parse_query
tools.description: Parse a query string/object (sql, cel, mongodb, jsonlogic, spel, jsonata, cypher, gql, gremlin, sparql) into an RQB query object (RuleGroupType, or RuleGroupTypeIC with options.independentCombinators). Use the result as the QueryBuilder `query`/`defaultQuery` prop. Pass options.fields to drop unknown fields. To go straight to another format, use convert_query instead.

input.description: Source query: string for all formats; mongodb/jsonlogic also accept an object. sql accepts a full SELECT or just the WHERE clause.

options.description: Parser options (subset common to all parsers; extras are format-specific).

fields.description: Field definitions: JSON subset of RQB `Field` — `name`, `label`, `operators`, `values`, `inputType`, `valueEditorType`, `valueSources`, `datatype`, etc. Array (option groups `{ label, options }` allowed) or object map keyed by field name. Function props (`validator`, etc.) are impossible over JSON. Strongly recommended: improves accuracy.

listsAsArrays.description: between/in values as arrays (default: comma-separated strings).

paramPrefix.description: sql only: named param prefix in input (e.g. ":").

params.description: sql only: values for `?` (array) or named (object) placeholders.

tools.name: convert_query
tools.description: Convert between query languages in one step (parse sql/cel/mongodb/jsonlogic/spel/jsonata/cypher/gql/gremlin/sparql → RQB query → any format_query format), e.g. SQL WHERE clause → MongoDB, JsonLogic → parameterized SQL. Returns the result plus the intermediate RQB query. Prefer this over separate parse_query + format_query calls unless you need to edit the intermediate query. `fields` applies to both steps.

tools.name: validate_query
tools.description: Validate an RQB query against a fields config: shape, IC alternation (rule, combinator, rule...), unknown fields, operator allowed for field, value arity (between/in), value type vs inputType, values-list membership, placeholders. Returns { valid, errors[], warnings[] }. Pass targetFormat (e.g. "qdrant") to warn about rules that format can't express. Run this on any query you generate before using it in app code.

query.description: RQB query object (`RuleGroupType` `{ combinator, rules: [...] }` or `RuleGroupTypeIC` `{ rules: [rule, "and", rule, ...] }`), or its JSON string. `id`s optional.

fields.description: Field definitions: JSON subset of RQB `Field` — `name`, `label`, `operators`, `values`, `inputType`, `valueEditorType`, `valueSources`, `datatype`, etc. Array (option groups `{ label, options }` allowed) or object map keyed by field name. Function props (`validator`, etc.) are impossible over JSON. Strongly recommended: improves accuracy.

queryType.description: Expected query type: "standard" (`RuleGroupType`) or "ic" (`RuleGroupTypeIC`). Omit to accept either.

targetFormat.description: Export format the query will be sent to. Rules it cannot express (e.g. vector DB formats like "pinecone", "chroma", "qdrant", "weaviate", "milvus") are reported as warnings.

tools.name: get_query_schema
tools.description: Generate a JSON Schema describing valid RQB queries for a fields config (wraps getQueryJsonSchema). Use it for LLM structured output / tool input schemas or Ajv validation. Set options.strict for OpenAI structured outputs. For app code, call getQueryJsonSchema from @react-querybuilder/core directly; this tool previews the output.

fields.description: Field definitions: JSON subset of RQB `Field` — `name`, `label`, `operators`, `values`, `inputType`, `valueEditorType`, `valueSources`, `datatype`, etc. Array (option groups `{ label, options }` allowed) or object map keyed by field name. Function props (`validator`, etc.) are impossible over JSON. Strongly recommended: improves accuracy.

strict.description: OpenAI structured-outputs compat (all props required, no extra props).

maxDepth.description: "ref" (default, recursive $ref) or max nesting depth (inlined, no $ref).

descriptions.description: Add field labels as descriptions (default true).

listsAsArrays.description: List values as arrays (default true) or comma strings.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the React Query Builder docs (v8.26.0, matching this package version). Returns ranked { title, url, snippet }. Follow up with get_doc for full content.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "parameterized sql", "custom value editor".

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Get a React Query Builder docs page (or one section, via #anchor) as markdown, by URL from search_docs or slug (e.g. "utils/export", "components/querybuilder", "compat").

page.description: Doc URL (from search_docs) or slug, e.g. "utils/export" or "https://react-querybuilder.js.org/docs/utils/export#sql". With an #anchor, returns only that section.

instructions: Tools for React Query Builder (react-querybuilder / @react-querybuilder/core). Use convert_query/format_query/parse_query instead of hand-writing query conversions, validate_query to check generated queries, and search_docs/get_doc for API details (docs pinned to v8.26.0).
